title: HSK1 Gate 19 · Ming Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 19: Ming Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第19关：明朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 明朝的时候，中国有一个很大的船队。带着船队的人叫郑和。他的船很大，比房子还大。船上有很多人，也有很多东西。
passageEn: In the Ming dynasty China had a very large fleet. The man who led it was called Zheng He. His ships were large — larger than a house. There were many people on board, and many goods.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Ming dynasty China had a very large fleet.
comprehension.answer: 明朝的时候，中国有一个很大的船队。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: His ships were large — larger than a house.
comprehension.answer: 他的船很大，比房子还大。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 时候 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“时候”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 时候 (shíhòu) means "period" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “时候”（shíhòu）的意思是“period”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 一 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“一”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 一 (yī) means "one" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “一”（yī）的意思是“one”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 明朝的时候，中国有一个很大的船队。

options.text: Long ago, the waters of China were very high.
The water was very big; many people had no home.
In the Ming dynasty China had a very large fleet.

check.explanationEn: "明朝的时候，中国有一个很大的船队。" means "In the Ming dynasty China had a very large fleet.".
check.explanation: “明朝的时候，中国有一个很大的船队。”的意思是“In the Ming dynasty China had a very large fleet.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Ming Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说明朝。
